svg.title: Spectrum VIII
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Twelve equal vertical painted panels. Twelve approximate hues retain the source sequence, grouped into color families for filtering; not colorimetric. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of orange, red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
